title: Smooth a bigram model and score a transcript
brief: Build an interpolated Kneser-Ney bigram model with perplexity, a Levenshtein aligner with WER and CER, and noisy-channel rescoring of n-best lists.
hints: zip(padded[:-1], padded[1:]) lists the bigrams of one padded sentence; Counter.update adds them all.
A Counter's keys are the distinct bigram types, so len(counts) is the denominator of P_cont and a count over keys gives N1+.
In kn_prob, C(history) is the sum of counts over the bigrams whose first element is history, which includes (history, '</s>').
Fill the edit table with E[i, 0] = i and E[0, j] = j first. On the way back, test the diagonal move first, then the deletion, then the insertion.
For corpus WER, keep two running totals, errors and reference words, and divide once at the end.
